headline: Executive order creates a new American Technology Council within the federal government.
what_it_does: This order sets up a group called the American Technology Council. Based on the title alone, the council appears to focus on technology issues within the federal government. No summary was provided, so details such as who sits on the council and what powers it has are not described here.

who_it_affects.how: Some federal officials may serve on or work with the new council, though the source material does not say who.

when_it_takes_effect: Signed April 28, 2017; the source material does not state a separate start date.
